svg.title: The level of the River Mole at Woodleigh from 30 October to 27 November 2026, against the bands that turn its marker amber and red, with the marker’s colour at each reading in a strip underneath
svg.text: River Mole at Woodleigh, 30 October to 27 November 2026

text.tspan: A river gauge’s marker is teal, amber once its level reaches 70% of the top of its typical range, and red above the top.
The strip under the chart shows the marker’s colour at each reading.
